author: jatinwadhwa921
title: GPU RoPE Tests fail — Intel proxy proxy-dmz.intel.com not resolvable when downloading HuggingFace models
signature: failed to resolve proxy-dmz.intel.com name or service not known|Network

failed_jobs.name: iGPU RoPE Tests / GPU_RoPE
failed_jobs.symptom: test_transformations_precommit fails with ProxyError: Unable to connect to proxy proxy-dmz.intel.com ([Errno -2] Name or service not known)

key_errors: urllib3.exceptions.NameResolutionError: HTTPSConnection(host='proxy-dmz.intel.com', port=912): Failed to resolve 'proxy-dmz.intel.com' ([Errno -2] Name or service not known)

urllib3.exceptions.MaxRetryError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='huggingface.co', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /api/models/hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM/revision/main (Caused by ProxyError('Unable to connect to proxy', NameResolutionError(...)))
root_cause: The iGPU RoPE test job runs model-hub transformation tests that need to download HuggingFace models via the Intel corporate proxy proxy-dmz.intel.com on port 912. During this run, DNS resolution for that proxy host failed with NXDOMAIN ([Errno -2] Name or service not known), preventing the test from fetching the model metadata. This is a transient infrastructure/network failure on the runner — the proxy host was temporarily unreachable or the runner's DNS resolver was unavailable. The PR changes (TFLite FE StableHLO RMSNorm dequantization) have no relation to this failure.
reproduction_steps: N/A — transient infrastructure DNS failure not reproducible locally.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed GPU_RoPE job; the proxy should be reachable on a fresh runner.
If the failure recurs, investigate the Intel internal proxy availability for the iGPU runner pool.
prevention_strategies: Add retry logic or a DNS resolution check before running HuggingFace model downloads in CI. Consider caching model snapshots so network failures during download are less likely to cause test failures.
historical_context: First recorded occurrence of proxy-dmz.intel.com DNS resolution failure specifically in iGPU RoPE tests. Similar proxy/network failures have been seen in other jobs (e.g., FinalizeArtifact ECONNREFUSED).
